evidence: Theorems under phi-mixing model (exponential/polynomial decay): subsampled SGD and mini-batch SGD improve sample complexity over standard SGD; unspecified numerical experiments.

evidence: Analysis of illustrative examples via dynamical stability and stochastic asymptotics; unspecified experiments in regression, classification, off-policy prediction.

evidence: Unspecified empirical tests of CNN deformation stability across layers and training, filter smoothness, pooling at initialization; natural image classification.

evidence: FFN-wider vs vanilla Transformers; reduced attention contribution; reallocating FFN parameters restores base capabilities; MoE models improve; unspecified tasks.

evidence: none reported
rationale: Descriptive title. Abstract asserts no degradation and high task-identification confidence without any reported experiment or theorem.
